stories.title: Mold Town Council launches free litter picking equipment loan scheme
stories.summary: Mold Town Council is offering free loans of litter picking equipment to residents, schools, community groups and businesses across the town. The scheme provides litter pickers, hi-vis vests, gloves and bags to anyone wanting to organise a clean-up event. stories.summary: Plans to open a dog exercise facility in Penymynydd have been turned down by Flintshire County Council’s Planning Committee.
